title: Conveyors
description:
This is a Spigot Plugin that aims to add conveyors for entities to Minecraft.

There are still many glitches, and I'd love if you reported them.
body:
This plugin adds conveyor belts to the game! You can push any entity with these belts. To make sure entities don't get stuck we center them on the conveyor, unlike other plugins.

To use them just **place Magenta Glazed Terracotta** in the direction you want them to go.

**Tip**: Entities will go faster if there is a Redstone block / powered Redstone under the conveyor.
( As of 3.0 )

*This mod should work in version 1.13 - 1.20.6, but versions have not been fully tested.
